title: 第3章  凭你，也配！
content_zh:
巨大天威压迫下，柳如烟全身灵气倒转，全部打入至尊骨！
一道金色玉骨虚影冲天而起，磅礴灵气呼啸，威压滚滚，直撼天雷！
可下一秒，至尊骨的所有反抗在天雷之下摧枯拉朽般崩碎，她身形便倒射而出，沿途鲜血喷薄，身下修行大阵直接被轰成废墟！
那冲天而起的金色至尊骨，光芒瞬间暗淡下去，飞回体内。
“啊！这到底怎么回事！那天雷为何会暴增！”
柳如烟震撼连连，强稳心神，慌张着吞下一颗丹药压制体内翻滚的气血。
此番竟偷鸡不成蚀把米，被天雷重伤！
那老妪声音也充满愕然：
“到底是什么人，能引发如此规模的灵珠雷劫？哪怕金丹初级强者的天雷，也远没有如此霸道！”
“你被雷劫重创，速速回去疗伤！你
“是，我
柳如烟强忍喷血的冲动，磨了磨牙，闪身进了圣女大殿。
这一击之下，若没有至尊骨帮她扛，她恐怕直接就灰飞烟灭了！
“徒儿，怎么回事？”
回到大殿内。
柳如烟的师尊，万剑宗圣女峰峰主姬邀月，看到柳如烟竟被伤成这样，也是一脸愕然！
“师尊！那雷劫不是我的，却伤了我！我现在的境界跌落灵珠八品，需要闭关疗伤！”
柳如烟银牙紧咬，眸中含恨。
“不是你的？”
姬邀月眸色更诧异：

“如此雷劫，除了你，万剑宗不会有第二个弟子能招引来！而且最近也没有长老要晋升……”
说完，她看向柳如烟：
“再过一个月，你便要接受血月圣地赤羽长老的考核，这可是杨巅峰引荐的机会，若是错过，进入血月圣地将会推迟整整三年！”
柳如烟急切道：
“师尊助我！”
姬邀月眯起眸子：
“想短期内修复雷劫之伤，唯有洗髓池！今晚月圆之夜，你随我进入洗髓池！”
“是！”
“今日之事，切莫外传！”
说完，姬邀月看向旁边一名弟子，声音冰冷：
“速速去查，那戮仙峰上，到底谁在晋升！”
“敢伤我爱徒，本座让他死！”
谁也没想到，雷云在戮仙峰上空，劈了足足三天三夜！
此时，山峰周围聚集了不少弟子，一些长老也被惊动，眼神复杂的看着戮仙峰，不明觉厉。
“这到底怎么回事？难道有重宝出世？”
“终于停止了，不知这地下究竟藏着什么？”
“前两年戮仙峰成了为弟子们开放的修炼场，据我猜测，下方定是隐藏着一条灵脉，而在其中修炼且能引发如此雷劫之人，非圣女莫属！”
“有道理！圣女天姿卓绝，又觉醒了至尊骨，一定是她冲击二品金丹才引发了如此天象！”
“我已经打探过了，圣女果然不在圣女峰！”
“如今雷劫结束，圣女就要出关了！好期待！”

“……”
众人一致认为是圣女在闭关引发雷劫之时，人群中，那被姬邀月派过来打探消息的几名弟子，眸色却相当复杂。
圣女的确不在圣女峰，可她也绝不会在这里，她已随着师尊去了洗髓池！
可师尊吩咐过，圣女受伤之事不能外传，所以他们此时也相当纠结，只能走一步看一步了。
此时，除了万剑宗上下都被这三日雷云惊扰之外，山门之外，高耸入云的山巅，数道身影遥遥观望。
“没想到，万剑宗又有妖孽出现，这三日雷云，足以说明他的天赋极高！”
“那又如何？区区雷劫罢了，我紫阳门天骄不比他万剑宗少！”
“雷劫终于结束，我等仍旧暗中观察，毕竟一个月后血月圣地就要在五门三宗选拔弟子，若万剑宗出了个绝世妖孽，我等还是要提前准备的。”
“呵呵，你紫阳门怕，我狂刀门可不怕，据我推测，万剑宗这次雷劫，除了那圣女柳如烟有此实力外，绝无他人！我狂刀门第一弟子秦战，早就与她交过手，就算她再晋一级，也不足为惧！”
“呵呵，到时候有血月圣地的高手亲自坐镇，鹿死谁手，倒是让人很期待……”
就在这时，忽然一声轰鸣响彻，大地震动，那被雷电劈得焦黑的土丘忽然炸开，烟尘四射！
“出来了！”
“圣女出关了！”
“这是晋升成功了，好大的阵仗！”
众人欢呼雀跃，满眼崇拜，振臂高呼！
可当一道人影终于出现在视线里，所有人都懵了。
这哪是圣女？
哪怕他披头散发，也能看出那是个男人！
“竟不是圣女？？？”
“此人是谁？”

“能引发天雷三天三夜不休，我万剑宗，难道又有高手出世？”
“……”
众人愕然，全蒙在原地。
陆烬也愕然。
他撩起长了三年的额前长发，扫视一圈，冷冷一笑：
“没想到，会有这么多人迎我出关！”
旋即，他再次扫视人群，却皱起眉头。
他找的，正是柳如烟！
经过这几日疯狂修炼，历尽万苦，如雷火煅烧，消耗足足八千灵石，他的境界终于突破至灵珠五重境！
虽没有恢复到曾经的巅峰九重，可他自信如今的战力远超曾经灵珠九重的自己！
而且经历过灵珠雷劫，他自信哪怕金丹二重强者，他都可立不败之地！
三年前柳如烟修为才四重灵珠境，虽说夺了自己的至尊骨，可三年时间，她也绝不会成为无敌存在！
扫视一圈没找到人，陆烬眉头皱起。
可就在这时，忽然有人认出了他，叫嚣的声音响彻山谷。
“他是陆烬！是那个勾结魔族害死同门的混蛋！”
“嗯？果然是他！他竟没死！”
“三年了，他还活着？这怎么可能！而且他的气息，好像很强！”
“难道他三年来，一直都在戮仙峰闭关？”
“他的丹田早已破碎，早没了修炼的资格！”
“可那雷劫又是怎么回事？”

“……”
众人议论开来，眸色却变得相当森冷！
一名长老掠至前方，咬牙切齿：
“陆烬！原来是你这孽障，你竟还没死！”
听着这话，再看周围众人一个个要吃了自己的眼神，陆烬眼眸眯起。
看来，当初柳如烟诬陷自己的那些话，还在蛊惑人心。
“呵，没把诬陷我之人手刃，我岂会死！”
陆烬猛然抬眸大喝：
“柳如烟那个贱人在何处，给我滚出来！”
此话一出，众人心下震惊，那长老粗声呵斥：
“大胆！圣女名讳也是你能直呼的！”
此话一出，陆烬眸色一变。
在万剑宗，只有晋升金丹境界，才有资格成为圣女！
三年时间，柳如烟果然突飞猛进，迈入了金丹之境！
可，那又如何！
金丹，他也定杀不饶！
看陆烬沉默，那长老冷笑道：
“陆烬，你没想到吧，如今的柳如烟，已经贵为我万剑宗圣女！”
“而且，一个月之后她便要进入血月圣地，接受赤羽长老考核，一旦通过，她便是血月圣地的人！而血月圣地也会因为她，对我万剑宗降下福泽，享受无尽好处！”
“而你，不过是个一无是处的废物罢了，交出你身上的宝物，本长老或可饶你不死！”

此话一出，众弟子议论纷纷：
“卢长老说的对！他三年前丹田破碎，这辈子都无法修炼，能引动天象，一定是他身上有不为人知的宝贝！”
“他师尊玄云子曾经可是个真正的高手！他只有这一个徒弟，死了之后好东西都留给这个混蛋了！”
“陆烬，你罪大恶极！当年在魔窟中害死了几十名师兄师姐，更是差点让圣女大人葬身魔窟，别说三年，就是三十年，我万剑宗都要将你斩杀，为死去的同门报仇！”
“还不乖乖交出宝物，跪下自裁谢罪！”
“……”
四处都是叫嚣之声，陆烬眸中寒光涌动。
他扫视四方，话语铿锵！
“三年前我身负重伤，无力反抗柳如烟和杨巅峰的诬陷！”
“如今我再说一次，魔窟之行，是她柳如烟联合杨巅峰害我，废了我的丹田，抢了我的至尊骨，且把知晓真相的弟子，全部坑死在魔窟之中！”
“若尔等只听她一面之词，继续栽赃陷害，那就休要怪我陆烬不留情面！”
此话说出，却听到一声嗤笑，那卢长老冷哼一声：
“陆烬，你休要胡说！”
“柳如烟是我万剑宗圣女，杨巅峰曾是我万剑宗圣子，如今更是血月圣地赤月长老座下亲传弟子，他们二人天资绝世，又岂是你能亵渎的！”
“今日你再次现身，只有一条路，那就是，跪下，以死赎罪！”
卢长老话音落下，身上灵气散发，赫然是灵珠七重境高手。
见此情形，陆烬知道对方没打算放过自己，他也明白，对方就算知道自己是被陷害的，他们也不会承认！
毕竟如今的柳如烟贵为圣女，而那杨巅峰更是成了血月圣地门徒，这都是他们得罪不起的存在！
弱肉强食的世界，弱小就是原罪，没有公平可言！
柿子专挑软的捏，他无论如何都会成为众矢之的。

所以，他冷笑一声，眸光带着杀意看向卢长老：
“区区一个外门长老，就凭你，也配！！”
content_en:
Under the pressure of the huge power of heaven, Liu Ruyan's whole body's spiritual energy was reversed, and all of it penetrated into the Supreme Bone!
A golden jade bone shadow rises into the sky, the majestic spiritual energy roars, the pressure rolls, and it shakes the sky!
But in the next second, all the resistance of the Supreme Bone collapsed under the thunder, and her body shot out backwards, blood spurting out along the way, and the practice formation under her body was directly blasted into ruins!
The golden supreme bone soaring into the sky dimmed instantly and flew back into the body.
"Ah! What's going on! Why did thunder increase so much that day!"
Liu Ruyan was shocked again and again. She calmed down her mind and hurriedly swallowed a pill to suppress the surging energy and blood in her body.
This time, he failed to steal the chicken but lost the rice, and was seriously injured by the thunder!
The old woman's voice was also full of astonishment:
"Who on earth can cause such a large-scale spiritual bead thunder tribulation? Even the thunder of a junior Jindan expert is far from being so overbearing!"
"You were severely injured by the thunder tribulation, go back to heal as soon as possible! You
"Yes, I
Liu Ruyan resisted the urge to spurt blood, gritted her teeth, and ducked into the Holy Maiden Hall.
Under this blow, if she didn't have the Supreme Bone to help her carry it, she would have been wiped out!
"Disciple, what's going on?"
Return to the main hall.
Liu Ruyan's master, Ji Yaoyue, the master of the Saintess Peak of the Wanjian Sect, was also shocked to see Liu Ruyan injured like this!
"Master! That thunder calamity was not mine, but it hurt me! My current state has dropped to the eighth level of spiritual beads, and I need to retreat for healing!"
Liu Ruyan clenched her silver teeth, with hatred in her eyes.
"Not yours?"
Ji Yaoyue's eyes were even more surprised:
"With such a thunder calamity, apart from you, Wanjian Sect will not be able to recruit another disciple! And there are no elders who want to be promoted recently..."
After speaking, she looked at Liu Ruyan:
"In one month, you will have to accept the assessment of Elder Akabane of the Blood Moon Holy Land. This is an opportunity introduced by Yang Dingfeng. If you miss it, entering the Blood Moon Holy Land will be delayed for three years!"
Liu Ruyan said anxiously:
"Master, help me!"
Ji Yaoyue narrowed her eyes:
"If you want to repair the damage caused by the thunderstorm in a short period of time, the only way is the marrow washing pool! Tonight, on a full moon night, you follow me into the marrow washing pool!"
"Yes!"
"Don't tell anyone what happened today!"
After speaking, Ji Yaoyue looked at a disciple next to her and said in a cold voice:
"Quickly check who is being promoted on the Immortal Killing Peak!"
"If you dare to hurt my beloved disciple, I will let him die!"
No one expected that thunderclouds would strike over the Immortal Slaughter Peak for three days and three nights!
At this time, many disciples gathered around the mountain peak, and some elders were also alarmed. They looked at Immortal Killing Peak with complicated eyes, not knowing how serious they were.
"What's going on? Is there a great treasure born?"
"It finally stopped. I wonder what is hidden underground?"
"In the past two years, Immortal Killing Peak has become a training ground open to disciples. According to my guess, there must be a spiritual vein hidden below, and the person who practices in it and can cause such a thunder disaster is none other than the Saint!"
"It makes sense! The Saint is so beautiful and has awakened the Supreme Bone. It must be her impacting the second-grade golden elixir that caused such a celestial phenomenon!"
"I've already made inquiries, and the Saint is indeed not at Saintess' Peak!"
"Now that the thunder tribulation is over, the Saint is about to come out of seclusion! I'm so looking forward to it!"
"..."
Everyone agreed that the saint's seclusion caused the thunder disaster. Among the crowd, the eyes of the disciples who were sent by Ji Yaoyue to inquire about the news were quite complicated.
The Saint is indeed not at Saintess Peak, but she will never be here. She has followed Master to the Marrow Washing Pool!
But the master had ordered that the saint's injury should not be reported outside, so they were quite confused at this time and could only take one step at a time.
At this time, in addition to the entire Wanjian Sect being disturbed by the thunderclouds for three days, several figures were watching from afar on the top of the mountain towering into the clouds outside the mountain gate.
"Unexpectedly, another evildoer appears in Wanjian Sect. The thunder clouds in these three days are enough to prove that his talent is extremely high!"
"So what? It's just a thunderstorm. I, Ziyangmen,Tianjiao is no less than his Wanjian Sect! "
"The Thunder Tribulation is finally over, and we are still observing secretly. After all, the Blood Moon Holy Land will select disciples from the five sects and three sects in a month. If a peerless evildoer emerges from the Wanjian Sect, we still have to prepare in advance. "
"Haha, you, the Ziyang Clan, are afraid, but I, the Kuangdao Clan, are not afraid. According to my guess, in this thunder tribulation of the Wanjian Sect, no one else has such strength except the saint Liu Ruyan! Qin Zhan, my number one disciple of the Crazy Blade Sect, has already fought against her, so even if she advances to another level, there is nothing to fear! "
"Haha, when the time comes, there will be masters from the Blood Moon Holy Land personally taking charge, who will win, which is really exciting..."
At this moment, there was a sudden roar, the earth shook, and the mound that was scorched black by lightning suddenly exploded, sending smoke and dust everywhere!
"Come out! "
"The saint is out of seclusion! "
"This is a successful promotion, what a big battle! "
The crowd cheered with joy, eyes full of admiration, and raised their arms and shouted!
But when a figure finally appeared in sight, everyone was stunned.
Where is this saint?
Even if his hair is disheveled, you can tell it's a man!
"Not a saint? ? ? "
"Who is this person? "
"It can cause thunder from the sky for three days and three nights. Is it possible that there is another master born in our Wanjian Sect? "
"..."
Everyone was stunned, and they were all covered in place.
Lu Jin was also stunned.
He lifted up his three-year-long hair from his forehead, glanced around, and smiled coldly:
“I didn’t expect that so many people would welcome me out of seclusion! "
Immediately, he scanned the crowd again, but frowned.
What he was looking for was none other than Liu Ruyan!
After these days of crazy training, going through a lot of hardships, being burned like thunder and fire, and consuming eight thousand spirit stones, his realm finally broke through to the fifth level of spirit beads!
Although he has not returned to his former peak ninth level, he is confident that his current combat power far exceeds that of his former ninth level spiritual bead!
And having experienced the Lingzhu Thunder Tribulation, he is confident that even a second-level Jindan strongman can be invincible!
Three years ago, Liu Ruyan was only at the fourth level of the Spiritual Pearl Realm. Although she had taken away her Supreme Bone, she would never become invincible in three years!
After scanning around and finding no one, Lu Jin frowned.
But at this moment, someone suddenly recognized him, and the sound of shouting resounded throughout the valley.
"He is Lu Jin! It's that bastard who colluded with the demons to kill his fellow sect members! "
"Um? Sure enough it was him! He is not dead! "
"It's been three years and he's still alive? How is this possible! And his aura seems to be very strong! "
"Could it be that he has been in seclusion at Immortal Killing Peak for the past three years? "
"His Dantian has been broken for a long time, and he is no longer qualified to practice! "
"But what happened to the thunder tribulation? "
"..."
Everyone started talking, but their eyes became quite cold!
An elder swept forward and gritted his teeth:
"Lu Jin! It turns out it’s you who is the evil one, and you’re not dead yet! "
After hearing this and looking at the looks of everyone around him that wanted to eat him, Lu Jin narrowed his eyes.
It seemed that Liu Ruyan's words that framed him back then were still confusing people.
"Oh, how could I die if I didn't kill the person who falsely accused me? "
Lu Jin suddenly raised his eyes and shouted:
"Where is that bitch Liu Ruyan, get out of here! "
As soon as these words came out, everyone was shocked, and the elder shouted harshly:
"Bold! You can also call the saint by her name! "
As soon as these words came out, Lu Jin's eyes changed.
In Wanjian Sect, only those who advance to the Golden Core realm are qualified to become a saint!
In three years, Liu Ruyan has made rapid progress and entered the realm of golden elixir!
But, so what!
Golden elixir, he will kill without mercy!
Seeing Lu Jin's silence, the elder sneered:
"Lu Jin, you didn't expect that Liu Ruyan is now the holy girl of the Ten Thousand Swords Sect! "
"Moreover, she will enter the Blood Moon Holy Land in one month and undergo the assessment of Elder Akabane. Once she passes, she will be a member of the Blood Moon Holy Land! And the Blood Moon Holy Land will also bring blessings to my Wanjian Sect because of her, and we will enjoy endlessDo your best! "
"And you are just a worthless waste. If you hand over the treasures on your body, I might be able to spare your life! "
As soon as these words came out, all the disciples started talking:
"Elder Lu is right! His Dantian was broken three years ago and he will never be able to practice in this life. To be able to induce celestial phenomena, he must have some unknown treasure in him! "
"His master Xuan Yunzi was once a real master! He only had this one apprentice, and after he died, all the good things were left to this bastard! "
"Lu Jin, you have committed a heinous crime! You killed dozens of brothers and sisters in the Demon Cave back then, and almost caused the Holy Lady to be buried in the Demon Cave. Let alone three years, let alone thirty years, I, the Wanjian Sect, will kill you to avenge your dead fellow sect! "
“If you don’t obediently hand over the treasure, kneel down and commit suicide to apologize! "
"..."
There were shouts and shouts everywhere, and a cold light surged in Lu Jin's eyes.
He glanced around and spoke loudly!
"Three years ago, I was seriously injured and unable to resist Liu Ruyan and Yang Dingfeng's frame-up! "
"Now let me say it again, during the trip to the Demon Cave, it was Liu Ruyan and Yang Dingfeng who harmed me, destroyed my Dantian, snatched my Supreme Bone, and trapped all the disciples who knew the truth to death in the Demon Cave! "
"If you only listen to her words and continue to frame her, then don't blame me, Lu Jin, for being ruthless! "
After saying these words, a sneer was heard, and Elder Lu snorted coldly:
"Lu Jin, don't talk nonsense! "
"Liu Ruyan is the holy daughter of our Ten Thousand Swords Sect, and Yang Dingfeng was once the holy son of our Ten Thousand Swords Sect, and now he is the direct disciple of Elder Chiyue of the Blood Moon Holy Land. The two of them are extremely talented, how can you blaspheme them! "
"Today you show up again, there is only one way, that is, kneel down and atone for your sins with death! "
After Elder Lu finished speaking, spiritual energy radiated from his body, and he was clearly a master of the seventh level of the spiritual bead.
Seeing this situation, Lu Jin knew that the other party had no intention of letting him go. He also understood that even if the other party knew that he was framed, they would not admit it!
After all, Liu Ruyan is now a saint, and Yang Dingfeng has become a disciple of the Blood Moon Holy Land. These are existences they cannot afford to offend!
In a world where the jungle prevails, weakness is the original sin, and there is no fairness at all!
Persimmon picks out the weak, and he will be the target of public criticism no matter what.
Therefore, he sneered and looked at Elder Lu with murderous eyes:
"You are a mere outer sect elder, and you are worthy of it! ! "
